html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, meet the Super Hero who has taken up arms
to create a world where Mutants can live in peace.

 

Tier-4 and a new Uniform have been added to Bishop,
who is ready to travel through time once again.

 

Agents, check out the new skills and power of the updated hero
by downloading the 6/17 Patch!

 

■ 6/17 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 6/18 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 6/17 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[6/18 (Wed) 2:42 (UTC+0), 6/17 (Tue) 19:42 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 6/18 (Wed) 2:38 (UTC+0), 6/17 (Tue) 19:38 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ One New Uniform

 

The new Uniform Bishop <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97> has been added.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The one new Uniform will be on sale for 40% off during the <The One from the Future Event> 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 


▣ Bishop Tier-4

Tier-4 advancement has been added to Bishop.
He will never stop training to survive the grim future.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ New Uniform Collection


Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes


1. Hot Deals from previous seasons will be sold again.
* The products will be displayed to Agents who have not purchased the product before.


2. To the Recommended Position for Sunspot <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97>, Support has been added.


3. Madelyne Pryor’s team effect 'Queen of Limbo' has been improved.
Previous: Physical Attack Increase +5.3%
Changed: Energy Attack Increase +5.3%

 

[6/19 (Thu) 2:59 (UTC+0), 6/18 (Wed) 19:59 (PDT) added]
4. The following items have been added to the list of items for sale in the Dimension Mission Support Shop (Material tab) 

- Component Pack, Stark-Branded Blueprint
 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
